display.purpose: Hero headlines. Outfit on main site; Playfair Display on AI landing. Different scales: 4rem max main site, 5rem max AI landing.

headline.purpose: Section titles. Outfit on main site; Playfair Display on AI landing.

title.purpose: Card titles, feature names, FAQ questions. Inter on main site; Lato on AI landing.

body.purpose: Prose, descriptions, testimonials. Inter 400 1rem on main site; Lato 400 1.125rem on AI landing. Capped at 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Navigation, tags, metadata, button labels. Inter 500 on main site; Lato 700 on AI landing.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Default card shadow. Barely perceptible separation.

shadows.name: ambient-medium
shadows.purpose: Elevated cards and image containers at rest.

shadows.name: ambient-high
shadows.purpose: Hover state for cards. Intensifies on interaction.

shadows.name: hero-glow
shadows.purpose: Video containers and featured images. Soft pool of darkness.

shadows.name: cta-glow
shadows.purpose: AI landing campaign CTA buttons. Warm glow on Coral Clay.

motion.name: fade-in-up
motion.purpose: Default entrance for hero text and sections. translateY(20px) → 0 + opacity.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, focus).

motion.name: ease-bounce-out
motion.purpose: Reserved for playful micro-interactions only. Never for page entrances.

narrative.overview: The Lauriana visual system grows out of a single metaphor: the body as a garden. This repo builds two independent brand surfaces that share a palette but speak at different volumes. The Main Site (portfolio, routes / /pt /en /es) is Restrained: Warm Sand ground, Deep Sage punctuation, Outfit + Inter type. Its job is long-term credibility for families of neurodivergent children. The AI Landing (campaign, routes /ai) is Committed: Mist ground, Verdant carrying 30-60% of surface, Playfair Display + Lato type. Its job is conversion for a 120-day autoimmune treatment. They do not share components, layouts, or typographic pairings.
keyCharacteristics: Two independent surfaces: Main Site (portfolio, restrained) and AI Landing (campaign, committed). They do not share components or type pairings.
Organic, not geometric: rounded-full buttons and 2rem card corners on the main site; 8px campaign CTAs and offer cards on the AI landing.
Two type voices: Outfit + Inter (main site) and Playfair Display + Lato (AI landing). Never mix the pairs.
Shadows are ambient, not structural. They create depth of field, not hierarchy.
Color commitment is split by surface: Restrained (sage + sand) on the main site; Committed (verdant + coral) on the AI landing.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule (Main Site)
rules.body: The primary accent (Deep Sage) is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Campaign Volume Rule (AI Landing)
rules.body: Verdant and Coral Clay are permitted to carry large surfaces because the page's job is conversion. But they must alternate with Mist and white breathing room. A wall of uninterrupted green reads as aggressive, not healing.

rules.name: The Warm Sand Doctrine
rules.body: Warm Sand is the main site's body background because the terrain metaphor demands it. The AI landing uses Mist. If a new surface cannot articulate why its ground should be sand-colored, use Mist or pure white instead.

rules.name: The Surface Separation Rule
rules.body: Never place Warm Sand and Mist on the same page. Each surface has its own ground. Cross-pollinating them breaks the architectural boundary between portfolio and campaign.

rules.name: The No Shouting Rule
rules.body: Hero heading max is 5rem on the AI landing, 4rem on the main site. Above that, the page is shouting, not designing. Display text uses -0.02em letter-spacing floor; anything tighter and letters touch.

rules.name: The Two-Font Max Rule
rules.body: Each surface uses at most two font families: one display, one body. The AI landing's Playfair + Lato pair is distinct from the main site's Outfit + Inter pair. Do not mix them on the same surface. Do not use Playfair on the main site or Outfit on the AI landing.

rules.name: The Italic Emphasis Rule (AI Landing only)
rules.body: Playfair italic is reserved for the hero headline's emphasized phrase. It is not used for body emphasis, nav items, or labels. One italic moment per page is voice; scattered italics are decoration.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus) or to anchor large media elements. Do not shadow every container.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: Backdrop-filter blur is used only on the AI landing's offer section as a deliberate brand moment ('the mist over the terrain'). It is not a default card treatment.

dos: Do use Deep Sage as a punctuation color on ≤10% of any screen on the main site.
Do use Verdant as a dominant surface color on the AI landing, but alternate it with Mist and white breathing room.
Do maintain 65–75ch line lengths for all body prose on both surfaces.
Do use Outfit + Inter on the main site and Playfair Display + Lato on the AI landing. Never mix the pairs.
Do reserve uppercase for short CTAs (≤4 words) and badges only.
Do use text-wrap: balance on h1–h3 for even line breaks.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: replace fade-in-up with instant visibility.
Do use Phosphor Icons (outlined style) for all interface icons. Inline as SVG where possible.
Do use pill-shaped buttons (9999px radius) on the main site and 8px-radius buttons on the AI landing. The shape signals the surface's emotional register.
donts: Don't place main site components on the AI landing, or vice versa. The Service Card's 2rem radius and Deep Sage hover belong to the portfolio; the AI Offer Card's 8px radius and Coral Clay border belong to the campaign.
Don't use Warm Sand on the AI landing or Mist on the main site. Each surface has its own ground.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as a colored accent on cards or callouts). The AI landing's hero quote currently uses this; it is a known deviation to be removed.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with gradients).
Don't use glassmorphism as a default card treatment. It is permitted only in the AI offer section as a deliberate brand moment.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number + small label + gradient accent).
Don't repeat identical icon + heading + text card grids without variation in size, imagery, or layout rhythm.
Don't place tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section heading. One deliberate kicker per page is voice; on every section it is AI grammar.
Don't use numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03) as default scaffolding. Numbers earn their place only when the section is a real sequence.
Don't use Warm Sand as a body background for new surfaces without the terrain metaphor justification. When in doubt, use Mist or white.
Don't let text overflow its container at any breakpoint. Test headings with the longest word in every language (pt/en/es).
Don't use marketing buzzwords: streamline, empower, supercharge, leverage, unleash, transform, seamless, world-class, enterprise-grade, next-generation, cutting-edge, game-changer, mission-critical.
